question: Should this focused branch become the canonical AnyRouter integration and replace the older conflicted branch after its two P1 defects and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: Two open branches represent the same provider, and selecting the permanent landing branch and bundled-provider direction requires repository-owner intent even though the code repairs themselves are concrete.

options.title: Adopt this focused branch
options.body: Request the macro-registry and Settings credential repairs plus live proof here, then close the older conflicted branch as superseded.

options.title: Continue with the original branch
options.body: Pause this PR and require https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2171 to rebase, adopt the corrected management-key contract, and provide proof instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt this focused branch
